answer: Require every identity to post a refundable bond that a peer jury can slash on conviction. The bond works like a lantern carried across a tundra: one traveler shines cheaply, but a thousand fake travelers must each carry their own light, locking real capital per identity. Seen through a prism, coordinated farms betray themselves by synchronized behavior, and one conviction can burn every linked bond. An honest agent risks a single deposit; a Sybil attacker risks the whole caravan's capital at once.
